definitions.meaning: Ready to perish, in danger of destruction

quotations.old_english: Ða tóweardan frecednyssa ðises losigendlícan middangeardes
Se ðe ða losigendlícan buruhware [people of Jerusalem] bemǽnde

source_text: losigend-líc; adj. Ready to perish, in danger of destruction :-- Ða tóweardan frecednyssa ðises losigendlícan middangeardes, Homl. Th. ii. 538, 7. Se ðe ða losigendlícan buruhware [people of Jerusalem] bemǽnde, i. 408, 6.
